messages.content: Find me a documentary about global warming.

function.name: retrieve_scientific_paper
function.description: Fetches the details of scientific research paper based on its topic. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

year.description: Year of publishing of the research paper. If not specified, fetches the most recent paper

message.content:
Sure! Here are a few highly regarded documentaries that explore global warming and climate change:

| Title | Year | Synopsis |
|-------|------|----------|
| **“An Inconvenient Truth”** | 2006 | Former Vice‑President Al Gore presents scientific evidence on climate change and its global impact. |
| **“Before the Flood”** | 2016 | Leonardo DiCaprio travels the world to investigate the causes and consequences of climate change. |
| **“Climate Change: The Facts”** | 2019 | A concise overview of the science behind global warming, featuring interviews with leading climate scientists. |
| **“The 11th Hour”** | 2007 | A global perspective on environmental degradation, including the role of human activity in climate change. |
| **“Our Planet” (Series)** | 2019 | While primarily a nature series, it highlights how climate change threatens ecosystems worldwide. |

If you’d like more details on any of these, let me know!
